summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation (BIPC) filed a 6-K announcing an adjourned special shareholder meeting on its proposed corporate structure simplification, now set for October 29, 2026, from the original meeting date; the record date remains August 21, 2026, with proxy deadline October 27, 2026. The plan combines BIP and BIPC into a single publicly traded corporation, Brookfield Infrastructure Partners Inc. (BIP Inc.). Boards of both entities unanimously approved based on special committee recommendations and fairness opinions from Scotiabank. Glass Lewis recommends FOR; ISS recommends FOR among BIP unitholders. Watch for quorum and vote outcome risk given the adjournment.
